rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for something that obstructs progress or creates difficulty.

example.english: This technical problem became an impediment to the progress of the plan.
example.traditional: 呢個技術問題成為計劃推進嘅障礙。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gei6 seot6 man6 tai4 sing4 wai4 gai3 waak6 teoi1 zeon3 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this specifically for an impediment affecting a person's hearing.

example.english: They have a hearing impediment and need to wear a hearing aid.
example.traditional: 佢有聽力障礙，需要戴助聽器。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 ting3 lik6 zoeng3 ngoi6 seoi1 jiu3 daai3 zo6 ting3 hei3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a speech or language impediment rather than a hearing problem.

example.english: The child has a speech impediment, and a speech therapist will help improve their ability to express themselves.
example.traditional: 個小朋友有言語障礙，言語治療師會幫佢改善表達能力。
example.jyutping: go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 jau5 jin4 jyu5 zoeng3 ngoi6 jin4 jyu5 zi6 liu4 si1 wui5 bong1 keoi5 goi2 sin6 biu2 daat6 nang4 lik6
